title: Divisible Game
summary: For a chosen k>1 and nonempty contiguous interval, each divisible value contributes +nums[i] to the score difference; every other selected value contributes -nums[i], not -1. Maximize the difference, then choose the smallest k attaining it. Return difference*k modulo 1000000007, normalized to a nonnegative residue.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
clarification: Authored illustration: for fixed k=3 and interval [9,5,12], the difference is 9-5+12=16. This illustrates scoring; it is not a claim that this interval and k are globally optimal.
questionResolution: Specific CLAUDE-QUESTIONS.md question answered; source confidence recorded separately.
